sources.message: BTC monthly price series spliced (CoinMetrics 2010-07 → 2014-08; Yahoo 2014-09 onwards). Authoritative for BTC structural signals (BTC-01..04). Last confirmed monthly close September 30, 2026. Next update due at the October 31 monthly close.

Gold futures front-month — SUBSTITUTE for the retired FRED LBMA series (methodology drift D-gold-2026-05-29). Weekly anchor 2026-10-23.

Spot-ETF net flows derived from the Polygon shares-outstanding weekly ledger (P4 route, 2026-07-11 — replaces the dead CoinGlass/Farside feeds). ETF-01 is suspended from the 2026-10-19 cycle: the share-count route cannot support a weekly evaluation, so the signal is scored UNAVAILABLE (0 points), not weak. Collection is still attempted weekly. Ledger: 15 records, 14 complete (a share count and a price for every fund); completeness does not show that the share counts are current, and their observation dates are not provided. The latest complete record is anchored 2026-10-23. A successful collection does not reactivate the signal.
